transcript: Customer: I was charged twice for my premium this month. Agent: Let me check that for you...
Customer: My claim has been pending for 2 weeks. Agent: I understand your concern...
Customer: This is the third time I'm calling! Nothing is resolved. Agent: I apologize for the inconvenience...
Customer: Can you explain my coverage details? Agent: Sure, let me walk you through...
Customer: I noticed two charges for my monthly premium. Agent: I can review the recent payments and help identify the duplicate.
Customer: I paid my bill last week but it still shows as overdue. Agent: I'll check whether the payment has posted to your account.
Customer: Could you tell me when my next premium payment is due? Agent: Your billing schedule is available here and I can go over it with you.
Customer: I was charged the old rate after my plan changed. Agent: Let me compare the charge with your updated plan.
Customer: I need a copy of the receipt for my last payment. Agent: I can help you find and download that receipt.
Customer: My reimbursement claim has been waiting for an update for three weeks. Agent: I understand the delay is frustrating and I'll check its status.
